name.ja: <ruby>白の繁栄<rt>ホワイト・プロスペリティ</rt></ruby>

text.en: Special Summon up to 2 Level 4 or lower WATER monsters from your hand, then if you control 2 or more monsters with the same name, you can treat 1 of them as a Tuner. If a WATER monster(s) is Special Summoned from your GY while this card is in your GY, and you have another monster in your field or GY with the same name as 1 of them: You can banish this card from your GY; draw 2 cards. You can only use each effect of "White Prosperity" once per turn.
